Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us for this game. Hope you enjoyed our coverage of this thriller. We look forward to your company for the final T20I of this series on February 1, 2017 at 1900 local (1330 GMT) in Bengaluru. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Man of the match, Jasprit Bumrah says he assessed the wicket and tried to learn from the English bowlers. According to him, he planned to bowl back of a length deliveries. He informs that he's aware of Buttler's potential. He says that there was more dew than he expected. Also says that he planned his fields according to the larger part of the ground. Bumrah also reveals that Kohli's confidence in him helped him a lot.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says that it was important to have belief and he didn't want the momentum to go away. Praises the spinners as well as Bumrah and Nehra for their bowling. Adds that Mishra was outstanding, and there was no need to bowl Pandya. Is pleased with the bowling performance. Kohli reveals that Bumrah was asking him every ball as to what should he do on the next ball, but the skipper asked him to back himself. Kohli admits Rahul played an outstanding innings as it was not an easy pitch.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan starts off by saying that they were in the driving seat till the last over and backed themselves to win. Rues the bad decision on the first ball of the last over as they lost the set batsman. Credits his bowlers for putting in another good performance after the first game. Mentions that the wicket didn't suit them but they adapted well with both bat and ball. Calls it disappointing to lose the game from where they did but now hopes to win the final one to clinch the series. Ends by saying that it has been a closely fought series and is looking forward to the final game.

England made a sedate start to their chase and then Nehra sent the openers back to the hut off consecutive deliveries to throw them off track. Morgan too struggled in his short stay at the crease. But Ben Stokes, who got a reprieve first ball as he was dismissed off a no ball, played an aggressive knock of 38 runs off 27 balls to bring the chase back on track. But as soon as he and Root got out, Bumrah stood up to help India level the series. The Indian spinners kept England in check as Amit Mishra led from the front with his spell of 4-0-25-1. Suresh Raina's contribution in the middle too was vital as he completed his quota of four overs at a decent economy rate.

With 8 runs needed off the last over, he kept his nerves in check to dismiss Root on the first ball itself. From there on, he made clever variations to make Jos Buttler's life difficult only to castle him on the fourth ball. Death overs bowling have cost India matches many a times, but not on this occasion. He bowled 9 dots in his last two overs to create immense pressure. Virat Kohli must be mighty impressed with the youngster.

Jasprit Bumrah is the man of the moment. When he came back into the attack, England needed 41 off 30 balls. The odds were in the visitors' favour. But one ball after another one, he bowled the slower deliveries to snatch the match away from Eoin Morgan and Co. The 18th over really did the trick for India, where Bumrah bowled four dot balls and almost scalped Joe Root's wicket off the last delivery.

Well bowled, Bumrah! INDIA WIN BY 5 RUNS! Slower one outside off, Moeen Ali backs away to loft it but cannot put bat to ball and that is it. Bumrah has his arms afloat to celebrate the win. What an over from Jasprit Bumrah, he conceded just 2 runs off the over. He ends with figures of 4-0-20-2 with 14 dot balls (9 of those in the last two overs). India level the T20I series 1-1!
Kohli and Nehra have a chat with the bowler.
Slower one outside off, Jordan fails to connect with his slog. They cross for a bye as Dhoni fails to hit the stumps. 6 needed in 1 ball now.
Chris Jordan is in next. 7 needed off 2 balls.

OUT! Timber! Bumrah keeps it on the stumps, Buttler looks to give himself room to drag it through mid-wicket but fails to make any contact and hears the death rattle. Bumrah is pumped up and rightly so. Buttler was not picking the slower one and by the time he picked this quicker one, it was too late. England under real pressure now.
Fuller length outside off, Buttler swings hard at it but fails to make contact. 7 needed in 3 balls.
Bowls it slower on the stumps, Moeen gives himself room and toe ends it towards cover-point for a single. Importantly, Buttler is on strike. 7 needed in 4 balls.
Moeen Ali is in next. Joe Root has a chat with him near the boundary line. 8 needed off 5! Ali on strike. Things getting tensed. England need Buttler on strike.

OUT! Bumrah strikes! Angles it on a length on off, comes in, Root looks to drag it through square leg but gets hit on his pads. The players go up in an appeal and the umpire rules it out. Big wicket for India, Root is not happy though. Replays show that there was an inside edge, India won't mind it though.

SIX! Just over Kohli! Bowls it wide outside off, Buttler manages to get it over long on from his crease. Kohli leaps up to take the catch at long on but only manages to get a hand to it. A big over for England that. 8 needed in 6 balls.

Fuller in length on off, Buttler hits it down to long off where KL Rahul was not charging at the ball and ends up conceding a couple of runs. He also threw at the bowler's end when Buttler was struggling at the striker's end.

FOUR! Vital boundary! Nehra follows Buttler who was moving across. Goes away from his plan and bowls it shorter. Buttler gets it through square leg for a boundary with a jab. That should relieve the pressure on England.
Kohli drops back to long on.
Too full on off, Root hits it back down the wicket to the bowler. Nehra fumbles a touch and concedes a single.
Slower one outside off, Root looks to go big but ends up getting it high in the air towards mid-wicket. The ball falls in the no man's land again. Root gets a couple of runs.
Bowls the yorker on the stumps, Buttler makes room and gets it towards covers for a single.
Kohli having a chat with his bowler. Dhoni and Yuvraj giving him a company.

Fantastic! Bumrah deceives Root with the slower one again as he looked to hit it towards deep mid-wicket and miscues. The ball is in the air, Pandya charges in from long on but it falls well short of him as England get a couple. 24 needed off the last two overs.
Another slower delivery, Root tries to reverse sweep, doesn't connect. Magnificent this by Bumrah.
Slower one, Root wants to go over covers and misses. Bumrah wants the ball back and asks Dhoni to toss it to him.
Length delivery, outside off, Buttler cuts it past the point fielder. Root wants a second, but Yuvraj makes a sliding stop to save one run.
Slower one, outside off, Buttler goes for the cut and misses.
Length delivery, on middle, Buttler is cramped for room and drives it to covers. England want to steal a single, but Kohli does well to not allow it.
Back of a length delivery, Buttler defends within the crease it towards point for a single.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! Slower one does the trick there. Stokes moved his leg across and wanted to heave it towards deep mid-wicket, but he misses it. Nehra goes up and the umpire reciprocates positively. Stokes is upset, India is happy! Important breakthrough. 28 runs needed off 19 balls. Can India strike once more to build more pressure?
Short delivery, chest height, Root pulls it, keeping it down, in front of square for a single.
Back of a length, Stokes comes down the ground and pulls it to deep square leg to bring Root back on strike.
50-run stand up between Root and Stokes!
Slower one, outside off, Root goes for the reverse sweep, doesn't get the connection and the ball rolls to short third man. Nehra is upset by Yuvraj's effort there as he concedes a single.
Full, around off, Stokes moves across and knocks it through mid on for a single.
Kohli calls back Ashish Nehra for a bowl. Last throw of the dice? England need just 32 more in 24 balls.
Fuller outside off, Stokes pushes it towards extra cover and takes Kohli on. Completes the single in time.
A good length ball on off, Stokes defends it watchfully from his crease.
A touch short but very wide, Stokes works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Strange shot but gets Stokes a boundary! Slips out a full toss outside off, Stokes gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Superb timing on that one.
Full outside off, Stokes manages to get it wide of the diving Virat Kohli at extra cover for a couple of runs.
Shorter length outside off, Stokes punches it towards extra cover. Kohli gets to the ball but gets hit on his left thumb. Is in some pain.
Jasprit Bumrah returns for a bowl. There is a change of ball with a lot of dew around.
Stokes comes down and pushes it through covers for a single. England need 41 more in 30 balls and are favorites from here on.
SIX! Top shot! Shorter outside off, Stokes gets enough elevation under it and thumps it over long on for a maximum. KL Rahul was waiting for it in the deep but could only watch it sail over him.
Drops it short watching Stokes coming down the wicket, the batsman though gets it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Lands it outside off, Stokes hits it hard but finds Kohli at extra cover who has to dive to stop the ball.
Flatter on the stumps, Root punches it through mid on. The bowler himself runs after it and stops it.
Sprays it wide outside off, Stokes mistimes his punch through mid on for a single.
Yuzvendra Chahal returns for his final over.
Tossed up, Stokes drives it to long off for a single.
A full toss, on middle, Root knocks it down to long on and runs one.
Root goes across and punches Raina to mid on.
Floated, around off, Stokes punches it to long on for an easy single.
SIX! Tossed up delivery, around off, Stokes dances down the track and whacks it to the long on fence for a maximum. He's looking to attack the part-timer here.
FOUR! Flatter and shorter, poor delivery, Stokes slaps it with a straight bat and gets a boundary in return. The long on fielder had no chance.
Root bottom edges it just past the leg stump. End of a top over from Mishra, his figures read 4-0-25-1!
Tossed up, Root looks to sweep and misses. Dhoni is quick there and clips off the bails, but Root is inside the crease. The crowd thinks there's an edge, but there was daylight between bat and ball.
Slower one, going in, Stokes pulls to mid wicket for a single.
Tossed up, spinning in, Stokes rocks back and defends it very late towards the bowler.
Slower in the air, on leg, Root nudges it towards deep square leg and runs one.
Flatter and shorter, Stokes pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. He's trying too many things, maybe he's disappointed with the no ball.
Raina fires it on the stumps, Stokes goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shorter on the stumps, Root sits down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Stokes pulls it through mid-wicket from his crease for a single.
Finally manages to get it wide of Kohli at mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Root fails to work it across the line. Raina appeals long and hard but the umpire says no. Replays show it was going down leg.
Three wides! Flatter down the leg side, Root fails to hit it away. Dhoni fails to stop it as well. Nehra runs after it and stops the ball in time. A couple taken along with the wide.
WIDE! Sprays it wide down the leg side expecting Root to come down. A wide is signaled.
Flatter outside off, Root punches it back down the wicket.
This one is outside off, Stokes defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the stumps, Stokes looks to defend but is beaten and hit on his pads. There is an appeal for the lbw but that was heading down the leg side.
Root works one through the on side for a single.
Too full on the stumps, Stokes manages to squeeze it past point for a single. That was bowled too quickly by Amit.

DRAMA! Stokes is bowled off a no ball! He is beaten all ends up! Bowls it on and around off from round the wicket, the ball spins away at the last moment and Stokes is beaten on his back foot. The ball goes onto hit the stumps and Stokes is completely taken aback. He is asked by the umpire to wait as they check for the no ball. And replays are not what Mishra would want to see, he has overstepped a long way and Stokes gets a reprieve. Free Hit coming up...
Ben Stokes is bowled. But the umpire wants to check for the front foot no ball.
Flatter on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Ben Stokes arrives.

OUT! Mishra strikes at last for India! How many times have we seen a batsman getting out after a drinks break! Mishra bowls the off spinner on the stumps, Morgan looks to go over long on but gets it off the top half of the bat. Hardik Pandya gets under it at deep mid-wicket and takes it safely. 200th wicket for Amit Mishra in T20s. India get a vital wicket. England need 80 more in 59 balls.
The fourth umpire signals the time to mop the dew around the ground with the rope.
An easy punch to long off for another single. Raina's chipping in with some quiet overs for India here.
Morgan punches this delivery towards covers for no run.
Floated, outside off, Root reverse sweeps it to third man for an easy single.
Tossed up, outside off, Morgan drives it in the air to long off to bring Root back on strike.
Slower in the air, on middle, Root tucks it to deep square leg and runs one.
Shortish delivery, around off, Morgan cut it through covers for a single.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire
Morgan flicks it to mid-wicket for no run.
Flat delivery, stayed low. Root drove it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Wrong 'un. Root looks to drive and inside edges it past the keeper. Nehra gives it a chase, but the ball beats him as it reaches the fence.
FOUR! Tossed up, on middle, Root shuffled across and swept it past the short fine leg. India would be disappointed with Nehra's effort here! He just gave up too soon. Kohli isn't impressed.
Short ball, around off, Morgan drives it to long off for a single to bring up the 50-run mark for England. It was an off break!
Kohli has a long chat with Mishra.
Morgan stays back and punches it past Kohli at extra cover for a single. England need 96 more in 72 balls.
Flatter outside leg, Root nudges it to short fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Root walks down and turns it towards mid on.
Bowls it on the stumps, Morgan makes room and punches it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Root works it through backward square leg for a single.
Slight hold up as one of the bail is not working and needs to be replaced.
Bowls it on the stumps, Morgan fails to sweep this one. They cross for a leg bye.
Suresh Raina is brought into the attack to bowl his part-time off spinners.

NOT OUT! Outside off, Root gets it to deep point for a run. They wanted the second and the throw comes in from the deep on the stumps. Dhoni takes the bails off and appeals. It is referred upstairs but the replays confirm that Root was comfortably in. Chahal was the fielder and he threw it with a loop and was not hard and fast enough to trouble Root.
Run out appeal. It's referred upstairs.
Floats it outside off, Root drives it through backward point for a couple of runs.
Shorter outside off, Morgan cuts it through backward point for a single.
Another googly on the stumps, Root gets it off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Slips it down the leg side, Morgan turns it towards short fine leg where Yuvraj dives and parries it towards square leg for a single.
Starts with a slider on middle, Root stays back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Time for the veteran, Amit Mishra to have a bowl.

Length delivery, on off, Morgan drives it back to Bumrah. India have dominated in the first six overs. Nehra scalped the two wickets and barring Chahal's second over, the Indian bowlers didn't allow easy runs.
Short, Morgan pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Slower one, around off, Morgan adjusted well and cut it past the cover fielder for a splendid boundary.
Good length delivery, outside off, Morgan cuts it straight to covers.
Short of a length, Root hops and glances it towards mid wicket through the toe end of the bat. One run added to the total.
Back of a length, on middle, Root gets hit on the pads as he tries to flick towards the leg side.
Jasprit Bumrah comes on for a bowl.
Googly and bounce. Root rocks back and defends it towards the off side. Brilliant comeback, this! Only 5 runs off it!
Tossed up again, spinning in, Morgan tickles it to short third man. Root sets off for a risky single, but in the end reaches comfortably.
Slower in the air, outside off, Morgan drives to mid off for no run.
Root punches this shortish delivery down the ground for a single.
Floated, outside off, Morgan leans forward looking to tuck it away, gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards backward square leg for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Extra bounce! Hurls it outside off on a length, the ball bounces more and Morgan is hit on his bottom hand. That bounced more on him.
Back of a length outside off, Root dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Kohli and Dhoni have a long chat.
Could have bowled this length on the previous ball. Slips this one on the stumps, Morgan gets his bat down in time to get it through fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
Not an ideal hat-trick ball. Lands it outside off on a length, Morgan has the easiest of leaves.
Skipper Eoin Morgan is in next.

OUT! Two in two for Nehra! Bowls this one on a back of a length on the stumps, Roy looks to punch it through mid-wicket but the extra bounce means that he fails in his attempt and the ball lobs towards mid on. Suresh Raina makes no mistake and India now have two in two. Ashish Nehra was hit around in the first game but has begun well today, he is on a hat-trick.
Joe Root is the new man in.

OUT! Nehra strikes! Shorter in length outside leg, Billings comes down the wicket to have a go at it with a pull shot. The ball gets big on him, he gets a top edge down to fine leg. Jasprit Bumrah in the deep, takes it watchfully. Superb bowling from Nehra to change his length to Sam. Kohli is pumped up and why not, India needed that wicket.
Billings is down to the pitch of the ball outside off and drives it through mid off for a single.
Almost through him! Bowls the wrong 'un on off, Roy does not pick it at all, plays for the turn and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards short third man for a single.
Too full on the stumps, Roy pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! Over the fence! Floats it outside off, Roy gets under it and dispatches against the spin over long on for a maximum. Magnificent strike!
Slips out a full toss, Billings is down the wicket and pummels it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Lovely shot! Tossed up outside off, Billings slinks down the wicket and clobbers it high and handsome over long on for a 76m maximum. Superb use of the feet there!
Full ball, Billings drives it to mid on for a single. Raina was a bit slow to react but it wouldn't have changed anything.
Dug in short, no bounce though. Roy pulls it straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length again, on leg, Billings flicks it to backward square leg for a single.
Length delivery, waist high, Roy drives it towards mid off, Kohli makes a diving stop and saves some runs for his team.
Change of bat for Jason Roy.
Full length delivery, outside off, Roy drives it to covers for no run. Roy is not happy with his bat and has exchanged it.
Back of a length delivery, Billings hops and blocks it towards leg side for a quick single.
Ashish Nehra to bowl from the other end.
Tossed up, around, Roy looks to play the reverse sweep over third man. Doesn't connect and hits it straight to short third man. Good start this for India, just 2 off the first over.
Floated, on leg, Billings tucks it towards backward square leg and runs one.
Tossed up, outside off, Billings cuts it straight to the cover fielder.
Slower in the air, spins a bit as it goes to Roy, he pushes to covers to score the first run for England.
Tossed up, around off, Roy defends it to Chahal.
Bowls this one, on middle, Roy leans forward and knocks it back to the bowler.
Welcome back for the chase! The two England openers Jason Roy and Sam Billings are out to bat. India not wasting any time and open the bowling with Yuzvendra Chahal.
